character_creation.method: Existing seeded oracle draws; no AI and no visible dice.

journey.start: Automatically drive after generating a character or resuming a ready save.
journey.resolved_events: After a short reading pause, resolve the current event and chained events, then depart automatically.
journey.interactive_events: Unresolved choices, NPC interaction, shops, buildings, replacement vehicles and battles wait for player action.

choices: continue if minimum travel cost is affordable
switch to a rested companion if available
fatigue_prompt.repeat: Once per departure; choosing continue does not repeatedly ask at the same stop.

journey.rest: Choose a watchkeeper in the same window; after safe sleep resume automatically when travel is possible. Existing sleep ambush rules remain.
journey.blocked: No fuel or broken vehicle waits for salvage; no automatic endless search.

layout.top: Current location and saved named Paradise distance, before title and party status.

message_window.overflow_choices: Previous / More pagination within the fixed window

layout.below_driving_scene: No dialogue, progress notices or continue panel; navigation remains available.

compatibility: Existing saves are normalized without rerolling people, destination, route or enemies.

publication.user_instruction: 每當更新完成後都允許自動上傳，不需要再確認
